newsitem.title: USA: First Midwest settles suit for $4.0 mln.
newsitem.headline: First Midwest settles suit for $4.0 mln.

text.p: First Midwest Bancorp Inc said Wednesday it settled for $4,050,000 a lawsuit, pending since 1993, against its former fidelity bond insurer.
The suit was related to loans charged off in 1992.
The settlement proceeds were credited to the reserve for loan losses. Management, meanwhile, is assessing the impact of the recovery on its loan loss reserves provisions and reserve levels, it added.
The assessment, First Midwest said, also will consider the impact of additional whole loan portfolio purchases. Management said it expects the assessment will be concluded within about 120 days.
No further details on the suit were available.
